passages.title: Little Red Riding Hood
paragraphs: It’s a bright and sunny morning. Little Red Riding Hood is on her way to her grandma’s home. She looks around and sees beautiful flowers growing everywhere. So she wants to pick some for her dear granny. “Good morning, Little Red Riding Hood.” Little Red Riding Hood turns around and sees a great big wolf, but Little Red Riding Hood doesn’t know what a wicked beast the wolf is, so she is not afraid.

passages.title: 短文 02
paragraphs: Hello, I am a girl. I’m from Shanghai. I am eleven years old. I study in Sunshine Primary School. I am in Class One, Grade Three. My classmates are friendly to me. I can read and write in the classroom. We like playing on the playground. Our class teacher is Miss Wang. She is tall. She is nice. She teaches us Chinese. We like her.

passages.title: 短文 03
paragraphs: Mike is the smallest monster in his class. He isn’t very popular with the other students. He is going to college soon. Mike chooses the greatest university in town - Monsters University (MU). MU is a very famous university. Its Scare Program is the most famous in the world.

passages.title: 短文 04
paragraphs: This is a picture of me. I am grey. I have a big head. I have two big ears. My nose is long. I am tall and strong. My legs are thick. People can ride on my body or my nose. I like eating fruits, such as oranges and bananas. I live in the zoo. Yes, I am an animal. I am very big. The tigers, lions and pandas are my neighbors. Can you guess who I am?

passages.title: 短文 05
paragraphs: It’s Jenny’s birthday today. All her family and at her birthday party. Look! Her father is taking with her grandpas. Her mother is baking the birthday cake. Her grandparents are sitting in the corner and talking about the weather. Her aunt Lisa is dancing with her uncle. What is Jenny doing now? she is standing in the yard and playing hide-and-seek with her friends. They are having a wonderful time.

passages.title: 短文 06
paragraphs: I am nine years old this year. My birthday is in November. I hold a birthday party at home. It is a happy party. I invite my classmates and friends. At my party, you can see nine candles on the lights. What can you smell? Yes. There is a cake. It is my birthday cake. My mother baked it for me. It tastes nice and smells good. I prepare some food and drinks for my guests, too. There are some sweets and orange juice on the table. They can eat the sweets and drink the orange juice. They will have a good time at my home.

passages.title: 短文 07
paragraphs: Hello, my name is Ben. I’m black and white. I have a long tail and small ear. They are white. My eyes are big and brown. My nose is white. I have a basket. I like sleeping in my basket. I like fish and milk. I don’t like dogs. I like playing with my ball.

passages.title: 短文 08
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Lily. This is a picture of my friend and me. My friend’s name is Amy. She’s eleven years old. She’s younger than me. She’s thin and short. She can play the violin very well. We are at Sam’s birthday party. Amy is playing the violin. I am singing and dancing with other people at the party. Everybody is having a wonderful time there. People are chatting, laughing and eating the cake. We are getting to know each other. It’s a special day.

passages.title: 短文 09
paragraphs: After dinner, Miffy wants to do a small shopping in the fruit shop with her five-year-old daughter Lily. “Wow! There are all kinds of nice fruits here, Mum.” Says Lily. “Yeah, what do you want?” asks Miffy. “I want some pears, bananas and peaches.” Says the little girl. “Can you eat them up?” her mum is very surprised. “Not only for me. Pears are for you and peaches are for my dad.” Lily answers. “You are really a good girl.” Says Miffy happily.

passages.title: 短文 10
paragraphs: A very rich man buys a farm in the country. He pays a lot of money because there grows a very old tree. The tree is over 500 years old. He tells all his friends about the old tree. However, none of them believe that. They all laugh at him. The rich man is angry. He asks his son Konny to check the age of the tree. A few days later, his son tells his father that the tree is 523 years old. His father is very happy and asks, “But how do you know its age?” “It’s so easy. We cut it down and count the rings of the tree.” Says Donny.

passages.title: A greedy man
paragraphs: A man has a good goose. Every day the goose lays a gold egg. The man soon becomes rich. But as he becomes rich, he becomes greedy. “The goose must have gold inside.” He thinks, “I can open it, and get all the gold at once.” So he kills the goose, but there’s no gold. The man cries and says, “I shouldn’t do that.”

passages.title: The Rose’s Annoyance
paragraphs: One nice summer day, the rose and other flowers in the garden are talking. Other flowers say, “We envy your beauty and your sweet smell! Now we understand why everyone loves you.” But the rose replies sadly, “Ah, my friends, I bloom only for a short time. But some of you never fade.”

passages.title: On the Farm
paragraphs: Hello, my name is Oliver. I’m on my grandmother’s farm. I come here every weekend to help her. She hasn’t many animals. There are two donkeys, some chickens, some geese, some sheep and two dogs. All the animals wake up very early in the morning. They want to get out of the barn and drink water. I give them water and the food. Then I play with the dogs and clean the barn.

passages.title: An ant and a butterfly
paragraphs: An ant is walking by the river one day, and he says, “How nice and cool the water looks! I must drink some of it.” as he begins to drink, his foot slips, and he fall in. “Oh, somebody, please, help me, or I will die!” a butterfly is sitting on a flower and hears him. She throws him a leaf, “Climb upon the leaf,” says the butterfly, “and you will float to the riverside.”

passages.title: Century Park
paragraphs: Look, this is Century Park. It’s in Pudong New District. It’s big and clean. There are many flowers, green trees and benches in it. On Saturdays and Sundays, we like to play in the park with our friends. We can ride bicycles, fly kites, row the boats and have picnics there. We can see many people sitting on the benches. Children like blowing bubbles. It’s a nice place for us all.

passages.title: A Terrible Time
paragraphs: I’m Ben. We are on vacation with my parents these days. We go to the Sunny Beach for a few days. We are all happy to be here, but to tell the truth, the weather isn’t very good. It is terrible here. It’s cold and windy. It’s raining heavily now. My brother and I have to stay in the hotel. We can only play tic-tac-toe and watch TV. My parents are having a big argument now. Oh! We are having a terrible time here.
